notes.title: Finalising Update
notes.content:
Improvements

[list]
[*] Added a much better story spanning all levels including an intro and end.
[*] Balanced the game to include a much better difficulty curve.
[*] Improved bosses.
[*] Added a couple of new characters to talk to.
[*] Balanced weapons.
[/list]

If you would like to receive updates about Revenge Quest 2, go [url=https://www.fyngames.com/revengequest/subscribe.html]here [/url]and enter your email.

Feel free to send bugs and feedback to me at support@fyngames.com

notes.title: Upcoming content
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Firstly, thank you to everyone who has supported me by buying and playing Revenge Quest. Special thanks to Jerryactric (Paintivity Universe on Youtube) for posting a playthrough online that proved to be an educational experience for me as I watched it through. Watch it here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MRYhxWekhAU&feature=youtu.be

Here's what's coming up soon in Revenge Quest:

1. Factories. Factories build randomised robots that evolve as you fight through each wave. It's up to you to fight and destroy the factories. As you do, the robots will become stronger, so be careful!

2. A dash of story. Someone needs to tell the story behind everything that's going on. 

3. A new level with new enemies and weapons (especially the Vacuum Gun, which sucks up bullets and shoots them back out.)

There will also be a bunch of small changes to give you a small advantage in some of the tougher areas of the game and to give better explanations.

That's all for now.

Joel from Fyn Games

If you'd like to make a suggestion, please send a message to gabrielajzen@gmail.com
